notes.title: Patch 1.15 - New Achievments and Leaderboard
notes.notes:
The new patch is here!

5 new achievements has been added, one including the "Enlightenment!" achievement. Which gives the lighter a new meaning, use it to light up all the candles. 

The leaderboard should also be up now, when you restart the game, you can now use the crowbar on the car before continuing. And it will start the speedrun, and when you escape the tunnel, your score will be uploaded to Steam leaderboard:

http://steamcommunity.com//stats/667060/leaderboards/2341935

notes.title: No Escape is finally here!
notes.notes:
No Escape has been released, if there is any questions don't hesitate to write a comment or a post on the No Escape forum. 

I would really appreciate if you can give a review on the steam page, all feedback is welcome and I am looking forward to have a dialog with you players on what works and what doesn't. 

I am working hard on getting the speedrun update out, but there has been some small problems. It will be out as soon as possible. 

The speedrun update is recommended to play after you completed the whole story, and acts as a way for you players to find the quickest way to get out of the tunnel. All you need to do to start the speed run is to use the crowbar on the car to get a new item which shows you the time you are using after picking it up.

So have fun, and good luck on finding your way out!
